name: Atlas Wire, LLC
old_description: Atlas Wire, LLC has served the electronic, OEM, and distribution markets since 1966.
about:
Atlas Wire, LLC was founded in 1966 in Itasca, Illinois. The company began as a supplier to the electronic, OEM, and distribution markets and has since expanded to operate a second facility in Tucson, Arizona. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures PVC, XLPE (cross-linked polyethylene), and nylon insulated electrical lead wires in single and multi-conductor constructions, covering sizes from 4 to 30 AWG. Its capabilities include extrusion, spiral striping, longitudinal line extrusion, twisting, heat bonding, respooling, and custom drum or spool packaging. Atlas Wire has produced over 4,900 distinct wire types across its two plants.

Atlas Wire serves the electronics, automotive, military, appliance, building and fixture, and industrial machinery sectors. Customers include OEMs and distributors that require UL-recognized appliance wire, machine tool wire, low-voltage automotive primary wire and battery cable, military hookup wire, and PVC-insulated building wire.

The company emphasizes a service-oriented approach, citing low minimum order quantities, short production lead times, and a willingness to accommodate special requirements as key differentiators. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.
